text:
alex_pm: proposing a "safety fanout" rollout for model-routing + quantization defaults. goal: reduce costs without user-visible regressions. plan sketch below, want ops/SRE/CS input.

alex_pm: outline -> 1) feature flag gate per-customer 2) micro-canaries (0.1% -> 1% -> 5%) 3) staged regions (us, eu, apac) 4) automated quality checks & shadow traffic 5) rollback catalog with pre-approved mitigations per severity

maria_sre: +1 high-level, need specifics on gating metrics and time windows. what's the stop condition for auto-rollforward?

alex_pm: suggested gating metrics: p95 latency delta <= 20ms, error-rate increase <= 0.1pp, generation-quality drift (BLEU-like) <= 1.5 pts on our eval set. hold window: 30m per step.

jordan_research: we can run continuous eval on held prompt set. propose an additional metric: sample-level divergence score > 0.2 triggers hold. also recommend adding a lightweight human review for final stage.

sophie_cs: need per-customer opt-out path. some enterprise customers will want to pin old config. include that in rollout: flag allows pin-by-tenant and a rollback label in billing UI.

rahul_eng: implementation notes: feature-flag keys and semantics, e.g. `ff:model_routing_v2:{tenant_id}`, use tiered flags for `fanout-stage` with values [off, shadow, canary, partial, global]. we can reuse our existing rollout API.

megan_sales: callout: for customers on Dedicated, we should not auto-roll quantization without contract sign-off. mark them as exempt by default.

maria_sre: ops concerns: what is the fallback plan if p95 spikes in one AZ but global metrics look ok? suggest regional circuit-breaker that routes to previous model variant in that AZ only.

alex_pm: agree. add regional fallback and per-AZ kill-switch. document mapping in rollback catalog.

jordan_research: on canary sizes: start at 0.1% global but ensure sample includes high-variance tenants -> add deterministic sampling by tenant id for first two steps so we exercise larger customers.

rahul_eng: telemetry checklist: latency p50/p95/p99, error counts, model token-rate, quality regression score, first-byte-time, cache-hit-rate. also track cost-per-token delta per route.

sophie_cs: ops for customers: CS should get proactive alerts for any tenant with >10% observed degradation and a link to opt-out toggle.

alex_pm: decision proposal: fanout tiers = [shadow -> canary(0.1%) -> canary(1%) -> partial(5-20%) -> global]. hold 30m per tier; require pass on automated eval + no critical alerts. manual approval required before partial and global unless emergency rollback is disabled.

maria_sre: add escalation ladder: auto-rollback for critical signals, page on severity-1, slack p2 for degradation. include a runbook pointer.

rahul_eng: I'll draft the flag schema and rollout orchestration PR. also adding decaying feature flags: `expires_at` so stale flags don't linger.

jordan_research: will author the eval suite + human-review checklist. need staging dataset and the sample prompts identified.

sophie_cs: I'll prepare customer comms template and opt-out flow steps.

megan_sales: heads-up: tell enterprise AE's before partial rollouts. I'll coordinate messaging.

deploy-bot: Created rollout ticket PROD-2987 and canary pipeline run id 2023-10-canary-77.

alex_pm: next actions: rahul to PR schema by EOD Thursday, jordan to deliver eval harness by Monday, maria to finalize SLO thresholds. I'll consolidate rollback catalog RFC and share v1 for review. :thumbsup:

maria_sre: noted. also adding a test in staging that simulates regional p95 spike to validate circuit-breaker.

rahul_eng: ack. planning to keep flag names short and searchable, example keys: `model_route_v2`, `quant_default_v2`, `fanout_stage`. we'll include a naming guideline in PR.

jordan_research: quick Q: how do we measure end-user visible regressions for chat sessions with long context? propose sampling whole-session transcripts and a session-level quality metric.

alex_pm: good call — add session-level metric to telemetry checklist.

sophie_cs: anything blocking customer opt-out implementation?
\rahul_eng: none, but need QA testcases. will add 6 quick tests to the staging pipeline.

megan_sales: can we add a one-pager for execs summarizing risk/reward? they'll want expected cost delta and conservative revenue impact assumptions.

alex_pm: will produce executive one-pager after we have PR numbers. aiming to start shadow traffic next week.

sophie_cs: :rocket:

alex_pm: thanks everyone — tagging for follow-ups: @maria_sre @rahul_eng @jordan_research @sophie_cs @megan_sales. we'll sync in Thursday triage if any blockers show up.
